# AstryxCard { #anylumino.AstryxCard }

```python
AstryxCard(children=None, *, variant='default', **props)
```

Render an Astryx card container.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default     |
|----------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| children | ChildInput | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`      |
| variant  | str        | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `'default'` |
| **props  | Any        | JSON-safe Card props. Useful keys: width, height, maxWidth, minHeight, padding, className, and style. The variant prop supports default, muted, blue, cyan, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, and yellow. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Card>. | `{}`        |
